name: myzelium
description: Shows your Claude Code sessions in Myzelium: what each one is working on, and which ones are waiting for you. Answer them from Myzelium's inbox when you start Claude Code with the Myzelium channel on; otherwise it only reports.

api_key.title: Myzelium MCP key
api_key.description: The chmcp_… key from Myzelium → Settings → MCP keys (the same one your Myzelium MCP connection uses)

api_url.title: Myzelium API URL
api_url.description: Leave as is unless you run your own Myzelium
